purpose: DeformView is a Slicer scripted module that turns a transform node (linear, grid, B-spline, thin-plate spline or composite) into dense displacement-magnitude and Jacobian volume-change volumes, shown as overlays with a hover readout and an incremental-application slider. It is aimed at registration researchers and image-guided surgery users.
summary: I found no malicious or concealed behavior. In DeformView.py I searched for pip installs, subprocess, network access, eval/exec and pickle and found none. The only file I/O is a temporary .h5 transform written and removed, plus a user-selected tag file read. The MIT license is present. The CMake installs every module the code imports, and the catalog entry is valid, with a branch revision and no dependencies. The main concern is global side effects when the module widget is first opened. It replaces VTK's global output window and resets Slicer's default color nodes. It also deletes every scene node named "JacobianMap". The 233 MB repository size flagged by the scan is above the 100 MB limit, and I could not verify it. Minor leftovers include stale placeholder text and unused files.
not_checked: Most of DeformView.py (about 3,700 lines) was only searched for risky patterns, not read line by line.
I did not run the self-tests or load the module in Slicer.
I could not verify the repository size or what causes it.
I did not verify that the main branch tip equals commit 8260b33.
I did not read the .ui file, the paper bibliography, or the workflow draft-pdf.yml.
